descriptionI18n.zh-CN: 地球绕太阳公转一年：地轴指向不变，太阳直射点南北往返，形成四季。
descriptionI18n.en: One year around the Sun: the fixed axial direction moves the subsolar point and creates the seasons.

teachingI18n.zh-CN: 太阳直射赤道，全球昼夜平分。此后直射点由赤道向北移动。
teachingI18n.en: The Sun is overhead at the equator and day equals night everywhere. The subsolar point now moves north.

teachingI18n.zh-CN: 太阳直射北回归线 23.5°N。北半球昼最长、夜最短，北极圈内出现极昼。
teachingI18n.en: The Sun is overhead at the Tropic of Cancer (23.5°N). The northern hemisphere has its longest day.

teachingI18n.zh-CN: 太阳再次直射赤道，全球昼夜平分。此后直射点向南移动。
teachingI18n.en: The Sun is overhead at the equator again. The subsolar point now moves south.

teachingI18n.zh-CN: 太阳直射南回归线 23.5°S。北半球昼最短、夜最长，北极圈内出现极夜。
teachingI18n.en: The Sun is overhead at the Tropic of Capricorn (23.5°S). The northern hemisphere has its shortest day.

bodyI18n.zh-CN: 公转方向与自转相同，周期约 365.26 天；轨道接近圆形。
bodyI18n.en: The orbit takes about 365.26 days and runs the same direction as the spin.

bodyI18n.zh-CN: 公转过程中地轴始终指向北极星附近，黄赤交角 23.5° 保持不变。
bodyI18n.en: During the whole orbit the axis keeps pointing near Polaris, so the 23.5° tilt stays fixed in space.

bodyI18n.zh-CN: 夏至太阳直射北回归线 23.5°N，北半球昼最长；冬至直射南回归线 23.5°S。
bodyI18n.en: At the June solstice the Sun is overhead at 23.5°N; at the December solstice at 23.5°S.

bodyI18n.zh-CN: 春分、秋分太阳直射赤道，全球昼夜平分，是四季的转折点。
bodyI18n.en: At the equinoxes the Sun is overhead at the equator and day equals night everywhere.
